title: Beyond Time: Plot Reaches Critical Point
seoTitle: Beyond Time: Emília in Danger, Melissa Takes Action
subtitle: The chapter that puts Emília in danger and Melissa into action
excerpt: The latest 'Beyond Time' episode sees Emília gravely injured after an accident, Melissa plotting to sabotage Felipe, and shocking revelations that alter the family's.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: Notícias da TV, Terra, Jornal Correio
contentHtml:
The chapter airing this Friday features Emília in serious condition after an accident, while Melissa (Paolla Oliveira) plans to sabotage Felipe (Rafael Cardoso) at her ex-husband's winery. The plot, already rich with family secret revelations, promises intense emotions.

Accident Puts Emília at Risk

Emília (Ana Beatriz Nogueira) suffered an accident after Alberto (Juca de Oliveira) revealed an old secret to her. The incident caused the character to lose concentration while driving, resulting in a rollover. Lídia and Felipe arrive at the scene, call for help, and quickly take Emília to a hospital.

Melissa and Pedro Conspire Against Felipe

Melissa (Paolla Oliveira) and Pedro (Emílio Dantas) are plotting against Felipe. Melissa invades the winery's cellar and cuts the power, destroying Felipe's new sparkling wine. Pedro attempts to interrupt the cave's refrigeration, but the plan fails, and he becomes irritated with Melissa's actions.

Family Revelations and Adoption Decisions

During the chapter, Raul and Gema decide to adopt Clara, while Zilda (Nívea Maria) returns from her spiritual retreat. Letícia informs Vitória (Irene Ravache), Lívia (Alinne Moraes), and Bernardo (Felipe Camargo) that Emília will make a good recovery, despite post-surgery complications.

Development of Secondary Characters

Dorotéia (Julia Lemmertz) discovers Melissa and Pedro's scheme, while Bento (Luiz Carlos Vasconcelos) cares for Alice (Klara Castanho) and shares a kiss with Rosa (Carolina Kasting). Gema ends her partnership with Queiroz (Zécarlos Machado) and expels the agent from the agency.

Impact on the Plot and Audience

The plot of 'Beyond Time' continues to explore family conflicts, corporate sabotage, and revealed secrets. This Thursday's (8) episode and Friday's (9) rerun promise to keep viewers in suspense, as the Beraldini family faces challenges that could definitively change their relationships.

Based on information from Notícias da TV, Terra, Jornal Correio.
